abstract.text: A note table keyed by time and pitch.
A protocol for types that represent a point in time.
A Boolean value indicating whether the note table contains no notes.
The interval type associated with the pitch type.
Returns a copy of the table with a note added using a start pitch and an end pitch.
Merges the notes from another table into this table.
Returns a copy of the table merged with another table.
Diminishes all note attack times and durations by a rational factor.
Calls the given closure for each note in the table, in order.
Returns a copy of the table with all note attack times moved by a directed duration.
Returns a copy of the table with all note times quantized to the nearest
subdivision.
Returns a copy of the table with all note pitches transposed by a directed interval.
Removes a note with a start pitch and an end pitch from the table, if present.
Inverts all note pitches around the pitch range of the table.
Returns a new wall-time note table by converting beat-time note attack
and release times using a tempo map.
Inserts a note with a start pitch and an end pitch into the table.
Augments all note attack times and durations by a rational factor.
Reverses the order of notes in the table within the current time range.
A Boolean value indicating whether any note in the note table carries extra data.
Transposes all note pitches by a directed interval.
A type that represents a musical pitch with an associated interval type.
Returns a new wall-time note table by converting beat-time note timings
and applying varispeed pitch shifting.
An error thrown by
operations.
A Boolean value indicating whether the note table is monophonic.
Returns the notes in the table as an array of note events.
Inserts a note with a single pitch into the table.
The closed range of times spanned by the notes in the note table, or
if the table is empty.
The closed range of pitches spanned by the notes in the note table, or
if the table is empty.
Removes a note with a single pitch from the table, if present.
Quantizes all note attack and release times to the nearest subdivision
given by the provided factors.
Moves all note attack times by a directed duration.
Returns a copy of the table with a matching single-pitch note removed.
Returns a copy of the table with a note added using a single pitch.
Creates a new, empty note table.
The duration type associated with the time type.
A note table keyed by time and pitch.
Returns a copy of the table with all note pitches inverted.
Returns a copy of the table with all note timings diminished by a rational factor.
Returns a copy of the table with all note timings augmented by a rational factor.
Returns a copy of the table with the order of notes reversed.
Returns a copy of the table with a matching portamento note removed.
A Boolean value indicating whether any note in the note table has portamento (differing start and end pitches).
A representation-agnostic musical composition model.
Returns a new beat-time note table by converting wall-time note attack
and release times using a tempo map.
